subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about putting {Brand} on a pay-per-validated-sale basis. One market shift worth flagging: Shopify's 2026 Global Commerce Report has merchant CAC climbing 16.1% to $318, and blended US ecommerce acquisition cost now sits between $68 and $84. As paid demand gets pricier, the cost that matters is the one per order that actually clears, which is exactly where cost-per-sale and an incrementality holdout protect your margin. Want to see how that lands against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: rising CAC (Shopify 2026 Global Commerce Report, sourced) + US ecommerce CAC band $68-$84
